summary: Pagination fails when using Elasticsearch 9.x with error indicating the query structure is incompatible. Temporal only officially supports Elasticsearch 8.x.
userImpact: Users cannot paginate through workflow executions when using Elasticsearch 9.x as the visibility store.
rootCause: Elasticsearch 9.x is not officially supported by Temporal; the query structure generated for pagination is incompatible with ES9 API
resolutionDetails: User was using Elasticsearch 9.1.2, which is not officially supported by Temporal. Temporal only supports Elasticsearch 8.x.
keyQuote: Just noticed that you are using Elasticsearch 9 which Temporal does not support at this moment. Please use Elasticsearch 8.
